subject: Is there exist 'grand' difficulty coefficient of gpcm model?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Is there exist 'grand' difficulty coefficient of gpcm model?
parts:
Hi, Phil.

I have to set up a booklet for the new standard setting. So I have to know 'grand' difficulty coefficient of each gpcm items.

How can I ordering that?

Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Is there exist 'grand' difficulty coefficient of gpcm model?
parts:
Hi Soengho,

It sounds like you want a Rasch rating scale/generalised PCM rating scale model, which mirt doesn't currently support. Not that it couldn't, I just haven't added it yet. There is a closely related rating scale model available with 'grsm', which has what you are after. 

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Is there exist 'grand' difficulty coefficient of gpcm model?
parts:
The warning was my mistake, and it patched on the dev now. You also want the 'rsm' input, not 'gpcmIRT' (which is related but not quite it, and would require a lot of modifications and constraints). So,

mod <- mirt(Science, 1, 'rsm', SE=TRUE)
coef(mod, printSE=TRUE)
plot(mod, type = 'trace')

The c parameter is the overall difficulty. If you want the slope parameters estimated (they are constrained to 1 by default) then you'll have to do this manually. 

Phil
